name: Getting Married
overview: Scripture reveals that marriage is a divine institution established by God, as He recognized it was not good for man to be alone and provided a suitable helper for him (Genesis 2:18). The union of marriage is characterized by leaving one's parents and cleaving to one's spouse, becoming one flesh (Genesis 2:24). Jesus teaches the sanctity and permanence of marriage, warning against divorce except in cases of fornication, emphasizing faithfulness and the serious nature of this covenant (Matthew 5:32). Believers are encouraged to trust God’s provision and seek His guidance in all aspects of life, including marriage (Matthew 6:25, 7:7).
